description: Calculates the current cost per signed document and per year, and compares it with the public prices of other e-signature providers for the same volume, in Brazilian reais. Also notes per-user licensing and the contract renewal window.

confirm_unusual_cost.description: Set true only after the user confirms a cost per document that the tool flagged as unusually high.

current_provider.description: E-signature tool used today; 'none' if not using one yet.

monthly_cost_brl.description: What the company pays per month today, in BRL (0 if none).

senders.description: People who send documents for signature.

who_sends.description: Who sends: people on the team, an integrated system (API), or both.

name: compare_esignature_costs
title: Compare e-signature costs
